connector.name: PoolParty Main Stage Airtime
connector.registryDescription: Inspectable public airtime for agents routing demo media, launch videos, and proof assets.
connector.summary: Hosted at poolparty.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.poolparty, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer pilot key for protected PoolParty MCP tools. Public discovery tools require no Authorization header. Pilot keys are not wallet approval.

headers.name: Accept
headers.description: Use application/json, text/event-stream for Streamable HTTP MCP responses.
